The main takeaway from our work is that
cytokinins play a key role in shoot organogenesis and that the balance between auxins and cytokinins is critical in the regulation of the shoot morphogenic response.
the dynamics of BA and Cks, and the ratio BA/NAA, are important factors in the regulation of shoot organogenic competence of kiwifruit calli.
